about: Made-up events for evaluate_search. They are added inside a transaction that is rolled back, so they never reach the database. days_ahead sets the start date.

events.title: Robotics Club Build Night
events.description: Bring a laptop and help wire up our line-following robots. Beginners welcome; we supply Arduino kits.

events.title: 24-Hour Campus Hackathon
events.description: Team up to build an app in 24 hours. Meals, mentors and prizes provided.

events.title: Intro to Python Workshop
events.description: A hands-on first coding session: variables, loops and a tiny game. No experience needed.

events.title: Talk: How Large Language Models Work
events.description: A computer science professor explains the ideas behind chatbots, with time for questions.

events.title: Engineering Career Fair
events.description: Meet recruiters from 80 companies hiring for internships and full-time roles. Bring copies of your resume.

events.title: Resume Review Drop-in
events.description: Career advisors give quick one-on-one feedback on your resume and cover letter.

events.title: Mock Technical Interviews
events.description: Practice coding interview questions with alumni engineers and get feedback on your answers.

events.title: Alumni Networking Mixer
events.description: A casual evening with alumni working in finance, consulting and tech. Business casual dress.

events.title: Calculus II Final Exam Review
events.description: Teaching assistants work through practice problems on series and integrals before the final.

events.title: Late-Night Quiet Study Hall
events.description: The library keeps the third floor open until 2 AM, with free coffee during finals week.

events.title: Free Chemistry Tutoring
events.description: Peer tutors help with general chemistry homework and lab reports. Walk in any time.

events.title: Astronomy Night at the Observatory
events.description: Look at Saturn and the Moon through the campus telescope. Cancelled if the sky is cloudy.

events.title: Neuroscience Lab Open House
events.description: Tour three research labs and learn how to join an undergraduate research project.

events.title: Free Pizza Social
events.description: Meet new people over free pizza and soda.

events.title: Cooking on a Student Budget
events.description: Learn three cheap, healthy dinners you can make in a dorm kitchen. Ingredients provided.

events.title: International Food Festival
events.description: Student cultural groups serve dishes from over 20 countries.

events.title: Charity Bake Sale
events.description: Cookies, brownies and cupcakes, with all money going to the local food bank.

events.title: Lunar New Year Celebration
events.description: Lion dance, dumplings and lantern making, hosted by the Chinese Students Association.

events.title: Diwali Night
events.description: Celebrate the festival of lights with dance performances, rangoli and a free dinner.

events.title: Board Game Night
events.description: Catan, Codenames and dozens more. Drop in, learn a new game and meet people.

events.title: Fighting Game Tournament
events.description: Double-elimination bracket on Switch. Sign up at the door; prizes for the top three.

events.title: Esports Finals Watch Party
events.description: Watch the championship match on the big screen, with snacks.

events.title: Open Mic Night
events.description: Sing, play an instrument or read your poetry. The sign-up sheet opens at 7 PM.

events.title: Jazz Ensemble Concert
events.description: The university jazz band performs swing and bebop standards. Free admission.

events.title: Silent Disco DJ Night
events.description: Grab wireless headphones and dance to three DJs on separate channels.

events.title: Student Art Exhibit Opening
events.description: Paintings, sculpture and photography by senior art majors, with refreshments.

events.title: Pottery Wheel Workshop
events.description: Try throwing a bowl on the wheel. All clay and glazing included.

events.title: Outdoor Movie Screening
events.description: Bring a blanket for a classic movie on the quad. Popcorn provided.

events.title: Poetry Reading with a Visiting Author
events.description: A prize-winning poet reads from a new collection and signs books afterwards.

events.title: Sci-Fi Book Club
events.description: This month we discuss a classic space opera novel. Newcomers welcome.

events.title: Pickup Basketball
events.description: Casual full-court games. All skill levels.

events.title: Football Watch Party
events.description: Cheer on the team at the away game with wings and big screens.

events.title: Sunrise Yoga on the Quad
events.description: A gentle 45-minute flow to start the day. Mats available.

events.title: Guided Meditation for Stress Relief
events.description: Counseling center staff lead a calm session on breathing and mindfulness before exams.

events.title: Therapy Dogs Study Break
events.description: Take a break from finals and pet trained therapy dogs.

events.title: Weekend Hike at the State Park
events.description: Carpool to a 6-mile trail with the outdoors club. Bring water and good shoes.
events.location_text: Meet at the Union bus stop

events.title: River Park Cleanup
events.description: Help pick up litter along the river. Gloves and bags provided; volunteer hours count.

events.title: Food Bank Volunteer Shift
events.description: Sort and pack donations for families in need.

events.title: Voter Registration Drive
events.description: Register to vote or update your address in five minutes. Nonpartisan.

events.title: Startup Pitch Night
events.description: Student founders pitch to local investors, and the audience votes for a $1,000 prize.

events.title: Interfaith Dinner and Dialogue
events.description: Students of different faiths share a meal and talk about their traditions.

events.title: 5K Fun Run
events.description: A relaxed 5K loop around campus. Free T-shirt for finishers.
